title: US Secretary of State issues statement on Czech Republic National Day
excerpt: Secretary Marco Rubio highlighted the security and commercial partnership between the United States and the Czech Republic on October 28, 2026.
bodyHtml:
On October 28, 2026, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio issued a statement to the Czech people to mark the anniversary of their independence in 1918. In the statement, the Secretary described the Czech Republic as a capable and trusted security partner for the United States.

The statement noted that both nations are committed to a strong NATO. According to the text, this commitment will require increased investment over the coming decade for each ally to meet the Hague commitment.

The United States and the Czech Republic also value close cooperation on energy security, which the statement says strengthens the dynamism and resilience of both nations. American and Czech companies continue to deepen commercial ties as they invest in each other’s markets and create jobs for workers. The Secretary expressed his wish for all Czechs to have a memorable celebration.
